ai.seo_question: What is the second condition of true repentance in Islam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this condition highlights the transition from mere verbal regret to a decisive, enduring commitment (ʿazm) that prevents relapse, distinguishing true repentance from temporary remorse. Sharif al-Radi presents this as a critical psychological and spiritual threshold, ensuring that the sinner’s resolve is firm enough to break the cycle of habitual sinning.
